items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, gated-product exposure, rights-dependent monetization, affiliate expansion, advertising, and alert expansion; conditional for ordinary reversible growth that preserves existing consent, disclosures, affiliate disclosures, claims, provenance, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Exact decision: keep searchwoot.com private, keep external outreach unsent, retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked, and authorize only existing bounded read-only evidence work. Evidence: compliance is 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown with open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings; fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only with $4.92 aggregate commission not site-attributable; security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner gates remain incomplete. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Progress: 0 of 4 legal tasks closed; 4 remain open. No task is closable on current evidence. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/display/alerts, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor/DPA coverage, and incident/request procedures. Do not send outreach, enable tracking, expand alerts, change the private gate, or expand monetization.

Woot API deal and price-history data: counsel_required and launch-blocked. Missing current written permission or API agreement, field-level rights/provenance, permitted storage, caching, display, historical derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. Missing deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional privacy review. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Missing log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps. No item is clear or conditionally launchable on current evidence.

Retain complicated.work and deadlymaracas.com parked. Their scaffold or parked state, missing analytics, and failed or unreachable compliance evidence do not support public launch or monetization. Next evidence action for each site: complete a timestamped site-specific checklist covering reachability, content, disclosures, compliance, analytics, monetization, and an explicit retain-parked or bounded-launch decision. Do not expose or monetize before completion.
